parsed.why: Same-sex offence repealed 2020; no trans-specific crime. Occasional 'modesty' charge misuse and common individual harassment, but no state-sponsored targeting; no LGR or anti-discrimination protections. Modest social friction, no documented border or facility exposure.

2024 law criminalises gender-affirming care and diverse gender expression (1–3 years), plus deportation and 'promotion' penalties. Documented anti-LGBT killings with impunity, UN calling state a perpetrator. Outed trans visitor faces arrest, detention and violence.

No trans-specific offence; hate-crime and hate-speech law cover gender identity, working prosecutions (30-year Pride sentence). Rising reports, low clearance and 8% reporting show real hostility, but state responses and protections function. No documented facility or border restriction.

No criminalisation; constitutional and statutory anti-discrimination and gender-identity procedure are strong on paper. But enforcement is weak (2017 ombudsman: murders uninvestigated, no sentences) and 2024 survey documents widespread exclusion. Paper protections not shown operating.

Sharia cross-dressing bans enforced by religious departments, official 'full licence' against trans people, rehabilitation orders, 377B raids detaining foreign nationals, prison male-ward violence and impunity. State-directed targeting; no protections; tourists occasionally caught.
